description:
Search deduplicated secondhand marketplace goods (electronics, monitors, routers, keyboards, heaters, furniture, vehicles, household items) aggregated across Telegram channels in Batumi and Tbilisi.
<hints>
- Powered by multilingual synonym expansion + semantic vector search: English queries (e.g. '4K monitor', 'WiFi router', 'electric heater', 'mechanical keyboard') automatically match Russian, English, and Georgian ads.
- Avoid overly restrictive 'category' values unless needed; keyword query alone searches across all categories with hybrid semantic ranking.
- Use sort='cheapest' to find lowest-priced items.
</hints>

fields.description: Optional array of field names to return

intent.description: Listing intent: 'WTS' (For Sale, default), 'WTB' (Looking to buy), 'GIFT' (Free), 'RENT', 'SERVICE'

sort.description: Sort order: 'relevance' (default when query is present), 'newest', 'cheapest', 'expensive'

name: search_classified_items
